subject.title: Clarify status of optional bird transport

question: Should Birdclaw continue publicly supporting and documenting the `bird` fallback, or should it be designated legacy/unsupported in favor of `xurl`?
rationale: Code and released documentation still expose the fallback, but only the package owner can confirm whether its deprecated and unavailable distribution is intentional, temporary, or retired.

options.title: Document xurl as supported
options.body: Mark `bird` as legacy or unsupported, remove the deprecated package installation recommendation, and direct new users to `xurl`.

options.title: Restore bird distribution
options.body: Republish or un-deprecate the package, restore an accessible source repository, and retain the documented fallback with a supported installation path.

recommendation.title: Document xurl as supported
recommendation.body: Mark `bird` as legacy or unsupported, remove the deprecated package installation recommendation, and direct new users to `xurl`.

likelyOwner.reason: The support commitment concerns a package and repository in this owner's namespace and requires product and distribution intent unavailable from current source alone.
